text:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1 alert for Sundance Health (dedicated-VPC). Elevated 5xx rate and timeouts from their dedicated GPU pool. PagerDuty: SDNC-4243.
alice_oncall: seeing 30% 5xx on model-sund-1-cpu at 23:12 UTC. Errors start ~23:08. Traces point to model runtime OOMs during long-sequence evals.
ben_sre: confirmed OOM spikes on node pool redwood-ded-sdnc-1, GPU mem stalls then container restarts. Autoscaler healthy.
carla_support: Sundance CS reported degraded responses in triage channel. They say critical workflows are failing (claims ingestion).
dan_runtime: looks like a model variant rollout happened at 23:00 — model-sund-1 -> model-sund-1-v2 pinned in routing. Canary passed but v2 has larger KV cache.
emma_acct_mgr: Sundance is on Dedicated Enterprise SLA. Need immediate mitigation and a customer-facing ETA.
frank_prod: priority = rollback pin to safe variant (model-sund-1-stable). But routing policy currently pins tenants to v2. We need a tenant override.
alice_oncall: can we do a soft fallback first? force route to safe variant for 10s windows to test. If fails, full pin revert.
ben_sre: safe variant fallback attempts failing: request routing returns 409 when trying to fallback because tenant pin rule exists and is higher precedence.
carla_support: @sundance-sre can you confirm whether your side started any heavy long-context jobs around 23:00?
sundance-sre: yes, we kicked off a bulk ingestion job for month-end claims at 22:50. Batch context ~12k tokens. We can pause if needed.
dan_runtime: pause request accepted. Sundance: please stop ingestion while we flip routing.
frank_prod: propose immediate tenant override via ops API. Example curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/tenants/sundance/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"override_type":"route","target_model":"model-sund-1-stable","ttl_secs":3600,"reason":"incident rollback"}'
```
ben_sre: I can run that. Will apply in 60s and monitor. Rolling to safe variant on 6 routing nodes.
alice_oncall: after override, throttle the batch jobs and enable prefix KV caching on safe variant for Sundance. Dan, can you flip cache policy?
dan_runtime: flipping cache policy now: enabling aggressive KV caching + lower max_seq to 2048 for this tenant. Command: `rehab_cache --tenant=sundance --policy=aggressive`.
carla_support: I told Sundance CA they're paused and to expect intermittent successful calls while we validate. Customer asked for ETA ~15-30 min.
emma_acct_mgr: I'll draft the customer update: "We have applied a temporary routing override to a safe model variant and paused large batch jobs. Engineers are monitoring for stability; next update in 15 min."
ben_sre: override applied at 23:16:18 UTC. Within 90s error rate dropped to 3%. Latency stable.
sundance-sre: we see successful responses now. Resuming backlog at reduced rate. Thanks.
alice_oncall: marking incident as mitigation-in-progress. Plan: keep override for 60m, monitor OOMs and latency, then either reintroduce v2 after memory optimizations or create a staged canary with smaller batch sizes.
frank_prod: followups: (1) audit why v2 KV cache blows memory under long sequences, (2) add automatic safe-variant fallback that can bypass tenant pins for P1s, (3) run load test with 12k-token contexts on v2 in staging.
dan_runtime: noted. I'll open runtime ticket and add a fast hotfix to kernel selection to avoid worst-case allocation during long sequences.
carla_support: Sundance asked for incident summary and root-cause when closed. I'll coordinate postmortem.
pagerduty-bot: PD note: escalation acknowledged by alice_oncall. Next oncall handover at 07:00 UTC; set follow-up to next shift.
alice_oncall: handing off to ben_sre for overnight monitoring at 23:40 UTC. Ben, please keep alert if error rate >5% for 5m.
ben_sre: ack. I'll monitor graphs and reconnect with Sundance if regressions. Will also validate the override TTL and extend if needed.
frank_prod: adding action item: product to review tenant pin precedence — we should allow emergency override flag that bypasses pin to safe variant for P1 incident runbooks.
carla_support: creating customer incident record and scheduling 1:1 postmortem with Sundance next business day.
alice_oncall: closing slack thread for now — escalation in PD remains open until next shift confirms stability. :white_check_mark:
